summary: The public Norris Stand site now does a better job explaining the official invite, portal approval, setup, and support flow for real customers.
The customer portal now gives clearer next-step guidance and official support links after sign-in instead of only showing raw license data.
Packaged Norris Stand builds now fail with a clear reinstall or support message if bundled Google setup assets are missing, instead of falling back to developer-style credential prompts.
